name_zh: 梅里/爱沙尼亚/歌唱革命/数字化转型：文化抵抗与数字国家
name_en: Meri/Estonia/Singing Revolution/Digital Transformation: Cultural Resistance & Digital Nation
description_zh: 阿诺尔德·梅里 (1929-2006) 爱沙尼亚总统 (1992-2001)/语言/文化/独立/苏联/歌唱革命/e-Gov/id卡/x-Road/互联网/数字化。核心模式：歌唱革命数字化转型 — 通过非暴力文化抵抗实现独立，以数字治理建设全球领先电子国家。体现 M257 歌唱革命/数字化转型 — 以"文化+数字+公民+创新"四位一体，在苏联/德国/民主化四重历史中构建爱沙尼亚范式。
description_en: Arnold Meri (1929-2006) Estonian President (1992-2001)/language/culture/independence/Soviet/singing revolution/e-Gov/ID card/x-Road/internet/digitalization. Core model: Singing Revolution/Digital Transformation — secure independence through non-violent cultural resistance, build globally leading e-nation via digital governance. Exemplifies M257 Singing Revolution/Digital Transformation — 'culture + digital + citizen + innovation' quaternity building Estonia paradigm in Soviet/German/democratization quadruple history.
reason_zh: 梅里非单纯技术官僚，而是"文化+数字+公民+创新"四位一体国家建构者。爱沙尼亚以语言保存民族灵魂，以歌唱革命争取独立，以数字化建设电子国家。M257区隔于其他波罗的海模式的核心在于"文化抵抗即独立基础+数字治理即国家能力+公民参与即合法性+创新输出即全球影响"的爱沙尼亚范式。
reason_en: Meri not mere technocrat but 'culture + digital + citizen + innovation' quaternity nation-builder. Estonia preserved national soul through language, secured independence via singing revolution, built e-nation through digitalization. M257 distinct from other Baltic paradigms core: 'cultural resistance as independence base + digital governance as state capacity + citizen participation as legitimacy + innovation output as global influence' Estonia paradigm.
